**SDI** (Blackmagic DeckLink capture + playout) is compiled into the two **`-full`** artefacts (x86_64 and aarch64). The **`-rockchip`** artefact does **not** include it — those boards are the embedded deployment, not a rack host with a PCIe DeckLink fitted. Autodetected at runtime exactly like NVENC: the edge `dlopen`s `libDeckLinkAPI.so` at boot and enumerates cards, so a host without Blackmagic **Desktop Video** installed — or with no DeckLink card fitted — simply does not advertise the `sdi-decklink` capability, and the manager UI hides the SDI input / output types for that node. There is nothing to configure and no separate build to install: fit a card, install Desktop Video, restart the edge, and SDI appears. Under the packaged systemd unit the card's device nodes must also be on the unit's `DeviceAllow=` list: this release's unit grants `/dev/blackmagic/io0`–`io7` (multi-channel cards) and `dv0`–`dv7` (single-channel cards), but a manager-driven upgrade never replaces the unit, so a host installed with v0.116.0 or earlier lacks the `dvN` grants until it gets a drop-in or a refreshed unit — see [docs/sdi.md](https://github.com/Bilbycast/bilbycast-edge/blob/main/docs/sdi.md#checklist-c--grant-the-device-nodes-under-systemd), Checklist C. The edge's boot log names any device node it cannot open.
